verses.text: Then Bildad the Shuhite answered:
"How long will you keep hunting for words? Think it through, and then we'll speak.
Why do you treat us like animals and count us unclean?
You tear yourself apart in your anger. Should everyone abandon the earth for your sake? Should the rock be moved out of its place?
The light of the wicked will go out. Their fire won't give off a spark.
The light in their tent will go dark, and the lamp over their heads will be put out.
Their strong strides will become short. Their own plans will bring them down.
Their own feet carry them into a net, and they walk straight into its mesh.
A snare catches them by the heel, and a trap holds them fast.
A noose lies hidden in the ground and a trap in their path.
Terrors frighten them from every side and chase at their heels.
Their strength wastes away, and disaster waits beside them.
Disease eats away at their limbs. Death's firstborn devours their bodies.
They're torn from the safety of their tents and brought to the king of terrors.
What doesn't belong to them takes over their tents, and sulfur is scattered over their homes.
Their roots dry up below, and their branches are cut off above.
Their memory disappears from the earth. No one speaks their name in the street.
They're driven out of the light into darkness and chased out of the world.
They leave no child or grandchild among their people, no survivor where they lived.
People who come after them are appalled at their fate, just as those who came before them shuddered.
This is what becomes of the homes of the unrighteous. This is the place of someone who doesn't know God."
